## Non-scientific style proof

This deterministic illustration checks shared fonts, type sizes, line widths, page dimensions, legends, facets, panel labels, layout and PDF/SVG/PNG exports. Values y = x/2, y = x^2/10 and y = k*x are illustrative, not research observations or results.
:::

### Task 1: Read verified inputs

The upstream manifest is accessed through path_source and checked against the 010 step-record hash. Both configuration files must match their 010 manifest entries.

```{r}
#| label: inputs
manifest_file <- rwv_step_input(step, path_source, "010-input-manifest", "input-manifest.tsv")
input_manifest <- rwv_read_tsv(manifest_file)
style_file <- rwv_project_input(step, "config/style.yml", input_manifest)
samples_file <- rwv_project_input(step, "config/samples.tsv", input_manifest)

style <- rwv_style_read(style_file)
samples <- rwv_samples_read(samples_file, style)
fonts <- rwv_fonts_resolve(style, cjk = FALSE)

knitr::kable(
  do.call(rbind, lapply(step$inputs, function(i) data.frame(kind = i$kind, path = i$path, sha256 = substr(i$sha256, 1, 16)))),
  caption = "Inputs verified for this run (sha256 shortened)"
)
knitr::kable(
  transform(samples, colour = rwv_site_colours(style)[as.character(samples$site)]),
  caption = "Sample dictionary (config/samples.tsv) with the fixed site colours"
)
knitr::kable(fonts[, c("role", "family", "resolved_family", "style", "postscript_name", "path")],
  caption = "Fonts resolved through systemfonts (no silent substitution)"
)
```

### Task 2: Deterministic illustrative values

```{r}
#| label: values
pt <- style$text_pt
ink <- style$colours$text
neutral <- rwv_chr(style$colours$neutral)
family <- style$font$family

x_b <- 0:10
x_c <- 1:4
proof_values <- rbind(
  data.frame(panel = "A", series = "sample dictionary", x = samples$sample_order, y = 0,
             rule = "position only", label = as.character(samples$sample_id)),
  data.frame(panel = "B", series = "Series 1", x = x_b, y = x_b / 2, rule = "y = x/2", label = ""),
  data.frame(panel = "B", series = "Series 2", x = x_b, y = x_b^2 / 10, rule = "y = x²/10", label = ""),
  do.call(rbind, lapply(1:3, function(k) {
    data.frame(panel = "C", series = paste("Facet", k), x = x_c, y = k * x_c,
               rule = paste0("y = ", k, "·x"), label = "")
  }))
)
rwv_write_tsv(proof_values, path_target("style-proof-values.tsv"))
```

### Task 3: Panels and layout

```{r}
#| label: panels
dict <- data.frame(sample_id = samples$sample_id, site = samples$site, order = samples$sample_order)
p_a <- ggplot(dict, aes(x = sample_id, y = 0, colour = site)) +
  geom_point(size = style$point_mm$sample) +
  geom_text(aes(y = 1, label = order), colour = ink, family = family,
            size = rwv_geom_text_size(pt$ordinary), show.legend = FALSE) +
  rwv_scale_colour_site(style, name = "Site colour") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.6, 1.6), breaks = NULL) +
  labs(title = "Sample order and site colours (config/samples.tsv)",
       x = "Sample ID in the configured order (number = order index)", y = NULL) +
  rwv_theme(style) +
  theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0))

curves <- proof_values[proof_values$panel == "B", ]
curves$rule <- factor(curves$rule, levels = unique(curves$rule))
p_b <- ggplot(curves, aes(x, y, linetype = rule, shape = rule)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = rwv_linewidth(style$line_mm$main), colour = ink) +
  geom_point(size = style$point_mm$sample, colour = ink) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("solid", "22"), name = "Illustrative series") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 1), name = "Illustrative series") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 10, 2)) +
  labs(title = "Axes, line, points and legend",
       x = "Illustrative x (arbitrary units)", y = "Illustrative y (arbitrary units)") +
  rwv_theme(style) +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.02, 0.98),
        legend.justification = c(0, 1), legend.key.width = unit(8, "mm"))

bars <- proof_values[proof_values$panel == "C", ]
p_c <- ggplot(bars, aes(factor(x), y)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, fill = neutral[2]) +
  facet_wrap(~series, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(title = "Facet strips and shared axes", x = "Illustrative category", y = "Illustrative value") +
  rwv_theme(style)

# Panel D is drawn in physical units inside an empty panel: the ruler must
# measure 50 mm on paper at 100 % scale, and every size label is rendered at
# the size it names.
ladder <- data.frame(
  pt = c(pt$minimum, pt$ordinary, pt$title, pt$tag),
  face = c("plain", "plain", "plain", "bold"),
  label = c(
    sprintf("%g pt: minimum for critical text", pt$minimum),
    sprintf("%g pt: ordinary text", pt$ordinary),
    sprintf("%g pt: titles", pt$title),
    sprintf("%g pt bold: panel tags", pt$tag)
  )
)
gp <- function(size, face = "plain") grid::gpar(fontfamily = family, fontsize = size, fontface = face, col = ink)
top <- grid::unit(1, "npc")
ruler_x <- grid::unit(0.5, "npc")
ruler_y <- top - grid::unit(11, "mm")
ticks_mm <- seq(0, 50, by = 10)
stroke <- grid::gpar(col = ink, lwd = rwv_lwd(style$line_mm$main), lineend = "butt")
scale_grob <- grid::gTree(children = do.call(grid::gList, c(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(ladder)), function(i) {
    grid::textGrob(ladder$label[i], x = grid::unit(0, "mm"), y = top - grid::unit(1 + (i - 1) * 5.5, "mm"),
                   just = c("left", "top"), gp = gp(ladder$pt[i], ladder$face[i]))
  }),
  list(
    grid::textGrob("Ruler at 100% print scale", x = ruler_x, y = top - grid::unit(1, "mm"),
                   just = c("left", "top"), gp = gp(pt$ordinary)),
    grid::segmentsGrob(ruler_x, ruler_y, ruler_x + grid::unit(50, "mm"), ruler_y, gp = stroke),
    grid::segmentsGrob(ruler_x + grid::unit(ticks_mm, "mm"), ruler_y,
                       ruler_x + grid::unit(ticks_mm, "mm"), ruler_y + grid::unit(2, "mm"), gp = stroke),
    grid::textGrob(c(head(ticks_mm, -1), "50 mm"), x = ruler_x + grid::unit(ticks_mm, "mm"),
                   y = ruler_y - grid::unit(1.2, "mm"), just = c("centre", "top"), gp = gp(pt$minimum)),
    grid::textGrob(sprintf("Stroke width %.2f mm", style$line_mm$main), x = ruler_x,
                   y = ruler_y - grid::unit(6.5, "mm"), just = c("left", "top"), gp = gp(pt$ordinary))
  )
)))
p_d <- ggplot() +
  annotation_custom(scale_grob) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(title = "Type sizes and physical scale", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  rwv_theme(style) +
  theme(axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank())

banner <- "NON-SCIENTIFIC STYLE PROOF"
banner_subtitle <- "Deterministic illustration; no research observations"
fig <- (p_a / (p_b | p_c) / p_d) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(12, 50, 24)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = banner,
    subtitle = banner_subtitle,
    caption = "Illustrative deterministic values only (style-proof-values.tsv); no research data or result is shown.",
    tag_levels = "A",
    theme = rwv_theme(style) + theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(family = style$font$family, size = pt$title)
    )
  )
```

### Task 4: Export the same figure object and verify it

Probe available graphics devices, then export the same combined figure object through path_target as PDF, SVG and 300 dpi PNG. Checks cover page dimensions, embedded fonts, text from every panel, minimum type size, line widths, the 50 mm scale and white background.

```{r}
#| label: export
width_mm <- style$figure_mm$width
height_mm <- 160
exports <- rwv_export_figure(fig, path_target, "style-proof", width_mm, height_mm, style, fonts)
proof_text <- c(
  banner, banner_subtitle, "A", "B", "C", "D",
  "Sample order and site colours (config/samples.tsv)", "Axes, line, points and legend",
  "Facet strips and shared axes", "Type sizes and physical scale", "50 mm"
)
qa <- rwv_verify_exports(exports, style, fonts, expected_text = proof_text, ruler_mm = 50)

export_record <- list(
  figure = "style-proof",
  scientific_content = FALSE,
  note = "NON-SCIENTIFIC STYLE PROOF: illustrative deterministic values only",
  run_id = step$run_id,
  width_mm = width_mm,
  height_mm = height_mm,
  png_dpi = style$export$png_dpi,
  files = lapply(seq_len(nrow(exports)), function(i) {
    list(format = exports$format[i], file = exports$file[i], device = exports$device[i],
         bytes = file.size(exports$path[i]), sha256 = rwv_sha256(exports$path[i]))
  }),
  device_probes = structure(as.list(exports$probe), names = exports$format),
  fonts = fonts,
  text_pt = style$text_pt,
  line_mm = style$line_mm,
  point_mm = style$point_mm,
  site_colours = style$site_colours,
  sample_order = rwv_sample_levels(samples),
  qa = qa
)
jsonlite::write_json(export_record, path_target("style-proof-export.json"),
                     auto_unbox = TRUE, pretty = TRUE, digits = NA, dataframe = "rows")
if (!all(qa$pass)) {
  rwv_fail("Style-proof export checks failed:\n",
           paste0("  ", qa$format[!qa$pass], " ", qa$check[!qa$pass], ": expected ", qa$expected[!qa$pass],
                  ", observed ", qa$observed[!qa$pass], collapse = "\n"))
}
knitr::kable(exports[, c("format", "file", "device", "width_mm", "height_mm", "probe")],
             caption = "Exports of the same assembled object")
knitr::kable(qa, caption = "Export checks (all must pass)")
```
